title: Minimax Contrast Risk in Balanced Experiments with Capped Sparse Event Totals
banked_reason: kernel_substituted@oeq:sharp-paired-frontier: required matched evaluated full-pair asymptotic equivalent not delivered; only unequal correction-order bracket, convergence and coefficient remain open. Independent validity gate confirms no bounded same-topic repair.
gap_reasons: kernel_substituted@oeq:sharp-paired-frontier — The proposal's required matched, evaluated asymptotic equivalent for the coupled full-pair deficit is not delivered: the core proves only the unequal correction-order bracket C_sp <= liminf Delta_K/K^(2/3) <= limsup Delta_K/K^(2/3) <= C_edge, leaving both convergence and the sharp coefficient open.

The correction-order bracket is a genuine, usable intermediate contribution, but its theorem-level novelty positioning remains conditional on incomplete full-text clearance of the closest unknown-binomial-size literature; the note should resolve or narrowly qualify the no-prior-paired-cap-frontier claim before presenting this bracket as a new frontier result.
proof_attempt_summary: Four discovery solve rounds derived first-order risk 4K and a correction-order bracket with certified endpoints 8.476699117 and 34.953278982, strengthening the legal complete-pair converse and original-record transfer regimes. The matched evaluated equivalent required by the durable topic was not delivered: a proper two-dimensional smoothed-deficit posterior-energy analysis and matching pair-dependent rule remain open. The mathematical referee passed the delivered bracket, but the decision referee found kernel substitution and an independent validity gate confirmed terminal failure; formalization was not entered and no Lean claim is made.
tldr: For one balanced binary experiment with fixed potential outcomes and separately capped potential-event totals, the unrestricted paired minimax contrast risk is \(4K-\Delta_K\), with \(\Delta_K\) of order \(K^{2/3}\). The proved bracket is \(8.476699117\ldots=C_{\mathrm{sp}}\le\liminf\Delta_K/K^{2/3}\le\limsup\Delta_K/K^{2/3}\le C_{\mathrm{conv}}=C_{\mathrm{edge}}=34.953278982\ldots\). The tighter converse comes from exact fixed-width complete-pair score asymptotics and a certified boundary-limit constant. A terminating rational full-pair rule attains the actual deficit relatively in the original experiment under \(N/K^{10/3}\to\infty\). The matched coefficient and properly smoothed-nuisance posterior energy remain open. The public cap is prospective; the motivating trial does not establish it.
gap: The unrestricted least-favorable construction in \cite{SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026SharpMinimax} is not proved to admit a restriction to the separate sparse caps preserving its sharp lower-bound energy. Equation (8) is a conditional null-coordinate randomization that can generate legal configurations after support restriction. No inspected primary result evaluates the full coupled capped correction. Finite-space binomial-size full-text clearance remains incomplete.
fill: The capped stress-test frontier evaluates \(\Delta_K\) with smaller-order remainder, a total observable attainer and an unrestricted original-record converse. The exact likelihood retains unknown overlap and both observed counts. Proper legal-prior joint-score analysis addresses the missing converse. The resulting precision benchmark measures nonlinear shrinkage gains within the declared class; an actual trial application requires independent justification of both counterfactual caps.
